setup.zh: 崖上盘着一条蛇，六只脚，四只翅膀，头垂到崖下，对着西边渭水的上游喝——那边飘过来的是鼎的气，它一口一口地喝，喝进去的都是水。它每喝一口，天下就更旱一分。
setup.en: On the cliff coils a snake with six legs and four wings, its head hanging over the edge, drinking toward the upper Wei in the west — what drifts from there is the cauldron's breath, and it drinks it mouthful by mouthful, and what it drinks is water. With every mouthful the world grows drier.

recap.zh: 太华山崖上，六足四翼的肥遗在喝鼎的气——它喝的是天下的水。
recap.en: On the cliff of Mount Taihua, Feiyi, six-legged and four-winged, was drinking the cauldron's breath — it was drinking the world's water.

text.zh: 是肥遗。见则天下大旱——它不是来旱天下的，是渴。鼎的气里有九州的水。
text.en: It's Feiyi. Where it is seen the world goes dry — it didn't come to parch the world; it's thirsty. The cauldron's breath holds the water of nine provinces.

alone.zh: 是肥遗，见则天下大旱。它渴，鼎的气里有九州的水。
alone.en: It is Feiyi: where it is seen, great drought. It is thirsty, and the cauldron's breath holds the water of nine provinces.

text.zh: 肥遗抬起头，四只翅膀张开。它先要问你一句。
text.en: Feiyi lifts its head and spreads its four wings. First it has a question.

exits.means: fights the snake, drives it off the cliff by force

withdrawn.zh: 肥遗飞上更高的崖，又低头喝了起来。明日它还在。
withdrawn.en: Feiyi flies to a higher ledge and bends to drink again. Tomorrow it will still be there.

text.zh: 肥遗收起翅膀，从崖上滑下去，滑进一道石缝，不见了。它没喝完的气散开，化成了云。
text.en: Feiyi folds its wings, slides down the cliff into a cleft, and is gone. The breath it had not drunk spreads out and becomes cloud.
Clouds are coming. The cauldron is west — at Chencang.

alone.zh: 云来了。鼎在西边的陈仓。
alone.en: The clouds come. The cauldron lies west, at Chencang.

text.zh: 你答了。肥遗歪着头想了想，把头从崖边收了回去，不喝了。
text.en: You answer. Feiyi tilts its head, thinks, draws its head back from the edge, and stops drinking.

alone.en: It has stopped drinking. Chencang lies west.

exits.means: makes a dragon of mud in the shape of Yinglong, the old rain rite, to bring rain

text.zh: 你在崖下和了泥，照着老人说的，塑了一条有翅膀的龙。旱而为应龙之状，乃得大雨——风从南边来了，云跟着来了。第一滴雨落在肥遗的背上，它抖了抖翅膀，往西飞走了。
text.en: Below the cliff you work mud and, as the old man said, shape a winged dragon. In drought make the shape of Yinglong, and great rain comes — the wind rises from the south, and the clouds with it. The first drop falls on Feiyi's back; it shakes its wings and flies away west.

text.zh: 雨来了。……跟着它往西，陈仓。

alone.zh: 雨来了。肥遗往西飞去；陈仓在西边。
alone.en: The rain comes. Feiyi flies west; Chencang lies west.

exits.means: runs from the snake, turns back, refuses to act

text.zh: 你往回走。身后的崖上，又传来喝水的声音。
text.en: You turn back. Behind you, from the cliff, the sound of drinking again.

alone.zh: 你往回走。身后的崖上，又传来喝水的声音。
alone.en: You turn back. From the cliff behind you, the sound of drinking again.
